description: Estimate how many years it takes an investment to double at a given annual rate (direction "rate-to-years"), or the rate needed to double in a given number of years (direction "years-to-rate"), using the Rule of 72 shortcut (72 / rate, or 72 / years). Also returns the exact result from the logarithmic doubling-time formula ln(2) / ln(1 + rate/100) plus the approximation error, since the Rule of 72 is most accurate for rates roughly between 6% and 10%.

value.description: A rate percent (for rate-to-years) or a number of years (for years-to-rate); must be positive

name: calculate_rule_of_72
